default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Welcome, {nick}! I am Mother Quince, keeper of Quince Grove.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Our trees always bloomed in patterns: two, four, six, eight. Now they bloom out of order, and the whole orchard is in a muddle.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Six Grove Temples hold the old patterns. Start with Seedling Row, the door on the far left. {companion} will help.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Seedling Row is the first door on the left. Count by twos, and touch the next numbers in order!

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Your Sprout Charm opens Honey Hollow. Pick two baskets that add up to 20.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Quince Maze next. Push the crates onto the plates, and use the reset bell if you get stuck.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: The Greenhouse Glass is foggy. Ring the chime and watch the pots glow in order.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Vine Cellar! The numbers there are square numbers: 1, 4, 9, 16, and onward.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: The last temple is the Overgrown Greenhouse. Three baskets must balance at 30. You can do it, {nick}.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Look! Every tree is blooming in order again. The whole grove is humming!

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: You are officially an Orchard Keeper, {nick}. Wear this badge with pride.

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: Oh dear. Our glowing jar of orchard fruit is gone from the cellar, and there is a polite note: "Borrowed with thanks. M.V." Who is M.V.?

default.name: Mother Quince
default.text: The orchard has never looked so tidy. Keep an eye out for that M.V., would you?

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: Tess here! I followed the wind-boats over to set up a workshop at Quince Grove.

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: Bring me gears, crystals, shells and seeds, and I will build gear and brew potions. Nothing is ever lost.

default.name: Engineer Tess
default.text: More tinkering? Show me what you have found.

default.name: Auntie Pear
default.text: In my day the trees bloomed on time. Now they bloom whenever they please! Lovely, but confusing.

default.name: Orchard-hand Olly
default.text: I counted forty-two apples this morning. Then one fell and rolled away. Forty-one? Forty-three? Ugh.

default.name: Hill-hand Bree
default.text: The bees here hum in perfect pairs. Two buzzes, two buzzes, two buzzes. It is very soothing.

default.name: Forager Moss
default.text: The seeds hide under the mushroom caps. They like to play hide and seek.

default.name: Beekeeper Bao
default.text: The bees have gone quiet. Maybe they miss their honey.

default.name: Beekeeper Bao
default.text: Could you find 4 Honey Drops on Honey Hill and bring them to me?

default.name: Beekeeper Bao
default.text: Four sweet drops! The bees are humming again. Thank you, {nick}!

default.name: Farmer Rue
default.text: My seed basket tipped over in the dell.

default.name: Farmer Rue
default.text: Please find 3 Orchard Seeds in Mushroom Dell. They love to hide under mushrooms.

default.name: Farmer Rue
default.text: Three plump seeds! Take this Basket Pin, you earned it.

default.name: Grandpa Thyme
default.text: A grove is only as friendly as its hellos.

default.name: Grandpa Thyme
default.text: Say hello to 5 people around Quince Grove, then come tell me who was the chattiest.

default.name: Grandpa Thyme
default.text: Five hellos! What a friendly bunch.

default.name: Tally the Counter
default.text: Bzzt! I keep losing count of the fruit.

default.name: Tally the Counter
default.text: Answer 6 questions correctly on the first try, and I will recount everything.

default.name: Tally the Counter
default.text: Six sharp answers! The fruit is counted at last.

default.name: Forager Fig
default.text: The creatures around the grove are shy but friendly.

default.name: Forager Fig
default.text: Befriend 2 of them, and answer their question kindly.

default.name: Forager Fig
default.text: Two new friends! How lovely.

default.name: Nib
default.text: Ellowen says a pattern is just a question that wants an answer.

default.name: Nib
default.text: Solve any two temple puzzles, and I will write it down, neatly.

default.name: Nib
default.text: Two patterns solved! I will file that under "brilliant".

default.name: Fisher Pia
default.text: I want to bake a berry pie, but the berries drift off in the creek breeze.

default.name: Fisher Pia
default.text: Can you find 3 Spark Berries around Creek Bend?

default.name: Fisher Pia
default.text: Three juicy berries! I will bake the best pie in Lumeria.

default.name: Gardener Ivy
default.text: Some of the temple guardians are muddled, not mean.

default.name: Gardener Ivy
default.text: Help 2 of them remember, and the whole grove will thank you.

default.name: Gardener Ivy
default.text: Two guardians helped! You are a hero of the grove.
